name: Anata no Sentaku de, Kanojo o Sukueru Kamoshiremasen
original_name: あなたの選択で、彼女を救えるかもしれません
source:
You work for a black company, and as you wander aimlessly through a bar district with no lights or liveliness in the middle of the night, a girl who appears in front of you appears in front of you.  Do you call out? 

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9231]the official website[/url]]
translation:
你在一家黑人公司工作，当你在半夜漫无目的地闲逛在没有灯光、没有热闹的酒吧区时，一个出现在你面前的女孩出现在你的面前。你喊出来吗？

[翻译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9231]官网[/url]]
